prompt: Some people believe that schools should focus mainly on academic subjects, while others believe that students should be taught practical skills that will help them in their future careers. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
While many individuals believe that schools should focus mainly on academic subjects, others think that students should spend more time learning practical skills for their future careers. From my perspective, schools should give more attention to practical skills because they can help students prepare for their future working lives.

One reason why some people think that schools should focus mainly on academic subjects is that this can help students achieve better grades and prepare them for higher education. This is mainly because if students spend more time studying subjects such as mathematics and science, they are likely to gain a better understanding of important academic concepts. As a result, they may have a better chance of getting into university and finding suitable career opportunities in the future. For instance, if students regularly study their academic subjects and complete their homework, they may achieve higher grades, which can help them enter universities and pursue successful careers.

On the other hand, others believe that schools should teach students practical skills because these skills can be useful in their future jobs and daily lives. This is mainly because students may not learn how to deal with real-life situations by studying academic subjects alone. As a result, learning practical skills at school can help young people become more prepared for the responsibilities they may face after graduation. For example, if schools teach students how to manage money, communicate effectively and solve common problems, they may become more confident when they enter the workplace.

In conclusion, although academic subjects can help students achieve good grades and prepare for higher education, I believe that practical skills are more important because they can prepare young people for their future careers and everyday responsibilities.
